messages:
olivia_ml: Heads-up: AcmeHealth submitted a request to onboard Hypatia-17B for clinical note summarization. Requirements: INT8 (or better) quant, streaming support, p95 <= 250ms for short notes, private deployment (HIPAA). Pilot in ~3 weeks. Need triage + bring-up checklist. HF/artifacts link: https://huggingface.co/acme/hypatia-17b

tariq_infra: Can you attach the actual model files + tokenizer type and any custom ops? Also need baseline fp16 perf numbers if they have them.

olivia_ml: Uploaded artifacts to s3: s3://acme-uploads/hypatia-17b/ (model.bin, tokenizer.json, config.json). Tokenizer = sentencepiece, vocab=32000. Model ~17B params. No custom CUDA ops reported. Sample prompt subset also in that folder.

jessica_se: Customer will send PHI. This must be Private deployment with KMS + audit logs. Legal confirmed BAA signed (cc @sophie_prod). Also need to verify data handling with infra before onboarding.

sophie_prod: Noted. Product side: will they pay for dedicated capacity during pilot? If yes we can fast-track pricing and SLA.

mike_perf: For quant smoke we should run a quick GPTQ/awq pass and perf smoke. @tariq_infra can you reserve a 2hr slot? Perf smoke command (example):
```bash
python infra/tools/smoke_infer.py --model s3://acme-uploads/hypatia-17b --dtype=int8 --batch 1 --seq 512 --iters 50
```
Expect p50 ~ 40-80ms on A100-80GB for seq128, we'll measure.

anna_eval: Proposed evaluation checklist to gate bring-up:
1) Tokenization parity tests (base vs customer outputs)
2) LM metrics: ppl / next-token loss vs fp16 baseline
3) Instruction-following eval (our clinical instruction set)
4) Summarization metrics: ROUGE/BERTScore on heldout clinical set
5) Safety/regression checks (medical hallucination heuristics)
6) Quantization quality: keep relative degradation <= 3% on ROUGE-L for pilot
7) Streaming correctness (no truncated tokens / continuity)

olivia_ml: Added clinical instruction set and 1k prompt validation set to s3://acme-uploads/hypatia-17b/promptset.json. Customer expects RLHF-like instruction handling, so include instruction-following metrics.

tariq_infra: Slot confirmed: 2026-05-07 10:00 PT. I'll reserve resources: 1xV100-32GB (debug), 2xA100-80GB (quant/throughput). Creating infra ticket and reserving a dedicated pool for the pilot.

deploy-bot: Ticket RED-8347 created: "hypatia-17b-quant-smoke" (assignee: tariq_infra).

anna_eval: Quantization recipes to test (initial plan):
- GPTQ 8-bit per-channel groupsize=128 (baseline)
- AWQ 4-bit g128 with outlier correction
- Mixed INT8 fallback for attention/query projection kernels
We'll run all 3 configs, compute ROUGE/BERTScore deltas and pick best quality/perf tradeoff. Request: pls provide 1k annotated validation prompts (clinical) with reference summaries.

mike_perf: Add streaming latency harness: `tools/stream_bench.py --model /path/to/model --concurrency 5 --seq 128` and a token-level latency trace. We'll compare p50/p95 across configs.

jessica_se: Ensure cross-account KMS keys and audit logs are enabled; I'll coordinate with infra to provision roles. Also add requirement: retain access logs for 1 year for compliance.

olivia_ml: Priority = high. Pilot kickoff in ~3 weeks. Owners: olivia_ml (PM/owner), tariq_infra (infra lead), anna_eval (quality), mike_perf (perf). I'll drive customer communications.

oncall-bot: Reservation made: Dedicated pool "RED-8347-pool" reserved on 2026-05-07 10:00 PT.

tariq_infra: I'll export sample outputs and perf logs to s3://redwood-results/RED-8347/ after the run. Subtasks: quant runs, export logits, perf traces, CUDA mem logs.

olivia_ml: Decision rule: if quant config shows >3% relative drop in clinical ROUGE-L, we'll fallback to fp16 or mixed-int8. If regressions are localized to hallucination signals, escalate to model team.

mike_perf: :thumbsup: I'll queue perf runs immediately after the reservation is active and post summaries here.

anna_eval: I'll prepare the evaluation notebook and thresholds, and link to it in the ticket prior to the run.

olivia_ml: Great — thanks everyone. Please post blockers here; I'll surface any legal/compliance asks to the customer.
